## Natural-language intents
- what is still running after I turned the automation off
- audit my AI agents and automations for persistence
- find orphaned cron jobs callbacks webhooks retries queues or credentials
- map how disabled or deleted agents could regenerate
- help me safely shut down an automation stack and prove it stays off
- audit my n8n Make Zapier cloud function or webhook stack for hidden persistence

## Boundaries
- the public diagnostic does not authorize credential revocation workflow deletion production shutdown or destructive testing
- do not send passwords API keys cookies tokens or private credential material through public intake
- remediation that can interrupt production requires separate explicit scope and authorization
- checkout is not payment proof and paid state requires authoritative verification

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.
